newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-Mahon, NZ Rowing Association part company.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-Mahon, NZ Rowing Association part company.

text.p: Harry Mahon's tenure as national rowing coach has ended because of differences in approach between himself and the New Zealand Rowing Association (NZRA), the New Zealand Press Association reported on Wednesday.
Mahon's term of appointment ended on Monday and he doesn't plan to reapply for the position.
"We acknowledge Harry's absolute commitment to rowing, but there were differences between Harry and the board over priorities and style of management," NZRA chief executive Mike Stanley said.
"It wasn't huge but there was some friction," Stanley said.
The NZRA are considering six applicants who are seeking the job. The new coach will be announced next month.
